title: Gertrude Schmeidler sheep-goat studies

tellings.quote: there was a parapsychologist who was active in the '50s, '60s, and '70s named Gertrude Schmeidler,

plain: Gertrude Schmeidler, a parapsychologist, someone who studies claims of psychic ability, is said to have been active in the 1950s, 60s and 70s, and is known for 'sheep-goat' studies, which compared people who believe in psychic ability ('sheep') with people who doubt it ('goats'). The researcher Herb Metts names her without giving a source, in an episode about a psychic spy program run by the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency. He mentions her as part of the background of serious research into psychic ability.
